title: Two-machine conductors: equal authority between the Air and Neo conductors
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Two-machine conductors" says the two conductors have equal authority: no lead; whichever conductor the owner is working with acts fully on what the owner says, with no extra confirmation; clashes are avoided only by claims (draft PR or In progress record), except that either may finish an owner-approved PR; a temporary area assignment by the owner is recorded on GitHub and changes nothing else.

The hearing conductor records each owner decision on GitHub at once without asking, and the other acts on that record as if the owner had said it in its own session, for merges, Ready, priority, triage, scope and design answers only; deploys, remote D1 migrations, secrets, production data and branch deletion still need the owner in the performing session. A web merge record is owner-approved applied by the hearing conductor, relied on through the owner-approval check on the current head; an iOS merge record is the hearing conductor's head-SHA comment. The hearing conductor finishes the merge unless the owner names the other or it hands over on the PR. Never granted agrees.
Cloudflare credentials are described as a machine capability, not a difference in authority; deploy permission is unchanged here (deploy approval from either conductor is RF-191).

CLAUDE.md points to the AGENTS.md section without restating its rules. The matching ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer and CLAUDE.md wording are updated by the Neo in an iOS PR the owner approves together with this one.
nextAction: Owner reviews and approves this PR together with the Neo's matching ritmofit-ios docs PR (AGENTS.md pointer, Merge gate, CLAUDE.md without "leads"), so the repos never disagree. Set Done once both merge.

evidence.summary: Owner request (Air session, 2026-11-03): equal authority between the conductors, no jarring pushback when working from the Neo; and "Yes, allow it with those safeguards" for deploy approval from either conductor (owner's words plus the main SHA recorded; the Air checks main still matches).

Final review round 3 (c7fc2c2) found the deploy-from-either rule still forgeable and incomplete (rollback, scope, runbook); the owner chose to split it out ("Yes, split #721", 2026-11-03, Air session) into RF-191.

After the split (owner: "Yes, split #721"): AGENTS.md Two-machine conductors (equal authority, decision records limited to merges/Ready/priority/triage/scope/design, web and iOS merge records, hearing conductor finishes), Never granted's owner-approved line and a pointer-only CLAUDE.md. The earlier deploy-rule, runbook and agent-prompts edits are not in this PR; they belong to RF-191.
